samples.title: Branch notebook: Proof strip
samples.statement:
A branching filing cabinet is checked from each parent folder into its left and right subfolders. Pia rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

Traverse the binary tree in root-left-right order and produce its node values. A missing root produces no values.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement branchNotebookProofStrip(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Branch notebook: Peak ticket
samples.statement:
A branching filing cabinet is checked from each parent folder into its left and right subfolders. Mina is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Traverse the binary tree in root-left-right order and produce its node values. A missing root produces no values.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement branchNotebookPeakTicket(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Branch notebook: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
A branching filing cabinet is checked from each parent folder into its left and right subfolders. Alma adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

Traverse the binary tree in root-left-right order and produce its node values. A missing root produces no values.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement branchNotebookBossReceipt(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
